paragraphs.en: Physical fidelity has received increasing attention in world models and video generation, yet how video representations encode physical information remains less understood. We introduce the World Embedding Benchmark, comprising 8,000 controlled simulation cases from 80 families spanning fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, dynamics, and optics & electromagnetism. Each case pairs a rendered video with simulation-derived physical annotations, supporting three complementary tasks: text-video retrieval, physical-property regression, and multiple-choice video-description pair classification. We use these tasks to distinguish cross-modal physical alignment from the recoverability of quantitative physical information. Evaluated pre-trained omnimodal embedding models show weak retrieval and near-chance within-family pair classification, while lightweight probes recover useful physical information from frozen video embeddings. Continual contrastive training with physics-specific video-text pairs improves retrieval and pair classification but degrades physical-property regression, revealing a trade-off between alignment and quantitative information recoverability. Finally, we use the embeddings to retrieve reference videos for retrieval-augmented generation with MiniMax-H3. Retrieved references improve the physical fidelity of generated videos, with stronger retrieval models yielding larger gains in our experiments. Together, these findings highlight the need to evaluate physical alignment and property recoverability jointly, and demonstrate the utility of physical representations for improving video generation.

paragraphs.en: Physical fidelity is essential to the ambition of using video generative models as world models: a useful model of the physical world must capture how systems behave under different conditions, beyond producing visually plausible scenes ( Bansal et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2025 ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . Recent evaluations have made this challenge explicit, revealing substantial gaps between visual realism and adherence to physical commonsense in generated videos ( Bansal et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) . This growing attention to physical fidelity raises a critical question about representation learning: what information about the physical world is preserved in video embeddings, and how accessible is that information? A representation may identify a scene as fluid flow or elastic deformation yet fail to distinguish changes in viscosity or stiffness. Such distinctions matter when embeddings are used to retrieve physical examples, estimate system properties, or provide reference evidence for generation ( Peruzzo et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 物理保真度对于将视频生成模型用作世界模型的宏伟目标至关重要：一个有用的物理世界模型必须能够捕捉系统在不同条件下如何行为，而不仅仅是生成视觉上令人信服的场景（Bansal 等，2025；Meng 等，2025；Kang 等，2025；Li 等，2026a）。 近期的评估明确揭示了这一挑战，表明生成的视频在视觉真实感与对物理常识的遵循之间存在显著差距（Bansal 等，2025；Meng 等，2025；Zheng 等，2025）。 对物理保真度日益增长的关注引发了一个关于表示学习的关键问题：视频嵌入中保留了哪些关于物理世界的信息？这些信息又有多容易获取？ 一种表示可能将某个场景识别为流体流动或弹性形变，但却无法区分黏度或刚度的变化。 当嵌入被用于检索物理示例、估计系统属性或为生成提供参考证据时，这类区别就显得尤为重要（Peruzzo 等，2025；Cheng 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating physical representations requires separating two capabilities: encoding information about physical quantities and aligning that information with language. A physical property may be recoverable by a trained probe even when embedding similarity cannot match a video to a description of that property. Conversely, successful matching of broad scene categories need not imply sensitivity to the parameters governing their behavior. Existing scientific simulation benchmarks provide rich resources for learning physical dynamics ( Takamoto et al., 2022 ; Luo et al., 2024 ; Ohana et al., 2024a ) , but evaluating multimodal embeddings calls for paired video-language observations and quantitative physical targets within a shared, controlled setting. This motivates a benchmark that measures both cross-modal alignment and the recoverability of physical information in video representations.
paragraphs.zh: 评估物理表示需要区分两种能力：编码有关物理量的信息，以及将这种信息与语言对齐。 即使嵌入相似度无法将视频与某项物理属性的描述匹配，训练后的探测器仍可能恢复出该物理属性。 反之，成功匹配宽泛的场景类别并不一定意味着对控制其行为的参数具有敏感性。 现有的科学模拟基准为学习物理动态提供了丰富的资源（Takamoto 等人，2022；Luo 等人，2024；Ohana 等人，2024a），但评估多模态嵌入需要在共享且受控的环境中提供成对的视频-语言观察数据和定量的物理目标。 这促使我们设计一个基准，用于衡量跨模态对齐能力以及视频中物理信息的可恢复性。

paragraphs.en: We introduce the World Embedding Benchmark , a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating physical information in video embeddings. It comprises 8,000 simulation cases from 80 families spanning fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, dynamics, and optics & electromagnetism. Each family contains 100 instances of a physical system with different parameter settings. We combine branch-specific simulation engines with analytical formulations and numerical integration where appropriate. These controlled configurations provide rendered videos together with their generating parameters and computed physical quantities, enabling evaluation beyond coarse scene semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了世界嵌入基准（World Embedding Benchmark），这是一个用于评估视频嵌入中物理信息的综合性基准。 该基准包含来自 80 个类别的 8,000 个模拟案例，涵盖流体力学、固体力学、动力学以及光学和电磁学领域。 每个类别都包含 100 个具有不同参数设置的物理系统实例。 我们结合了各分支专用的模拟引擎，并在适当情况下融入了解析公式和数值积分方法。 这些受控配置提供了渲染后的视频及其生成参数和计算出的物理量，从而能够进行超越粗略场景语义的评估。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark supports three complementary tasks. Text-video retrieval measures cross-modal matching between physical descriptions and simulation videos. Physical-property regression measures whether lightweight probes can recover continuous physical quantities from frozen video embeddings. Pair classification asks models to select the correct video-description pair from a small set of candidates. Together, these tasks assess cross-modal physical alignment, quantitative information recoverability, and fine-grained physical discrimination. Using this benchmark, we investigate three research questions.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate pre-trained omnimodal embedding models and find a marked discrepancy across tasks: text-video retrieval and within-family pair classification remain close to their respective chance baselines, whereas lightweight regression probes recover useful physical information from frozen video representations. These results suggest that the evaluated embeddings retain signals predictive of physical properties, but that these signals are not readily accessible through cross-modal similarity. Directly prompted MLLMs perform substantially better on pair classification, suggesting that relevant physical capabilities exist but are not fully exposed in embedding space.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了预训练的全模态嵌入模型，并发现不同任务之间存在显著差异：文本-视频检索和家族内成对分类任务的准确率仍接近各自的机会基线，而轻量回归探针却能从冻结的视频表示中恢复出有用的物理信息。 这些结果表明，所评估的嵌入模型保留了能够预测物理属性的信号，但这些信号无法通过跨模态相似性轻易获取。 直接提示的 MLLM 在成对分类任务上的表现明显更好，这表明相关的物理能力确实存在，但在嵌入空间中并未完全显现。

paragraphs.en: We investigate whether adding physics-specific video-text pairs to continual contrastive training improves the physical alignment of pre-trained embeddings. Adaptation improves retrieval and pair classification, but reduces physical-property regression. This trade-off suggests that organizing embeddings for cross-modal matching can compromise the recoverability of quantitative physical information. Overall, these results suggest that contrastive training primarily reorganizes and aligns existing physical signals in the representation space, rather than substantially enhancing the underlying physical capabilities.

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are three-fold: (1) We introduce the World Embedding Benchmark, comprising 8,000 controlled simulation cases across 80 physical families and three complementary tasks for evaluating physical representations. (2) We identify a gap between physical information encoded by multimodal models and its cross-modal alignment in embedding space, and show that contrastive adaptation improves alignment while degrading physical-property regression. (3) We demonstrate the downstream utility of physical embeddings for retrieval-augmented video generation, connecting stronger physical retrieval performance to improved physical fidelity of generated videos. More broadly, these results point to physically grounded representations as a useful bridge between understanding physical systems and improving generative world models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面：(1) 我们提出了世界嵌入基准，该基准包含 80 个物理家族和三个互补任务中的 8,000 个受控模拟案例，用于评估物理表示。 (2) 我们发现多模态模型所编码的物理信息与其在嵌入空间中的跨模态对齐之间存在差距，并证明对比适应能够提升对齐效果，但会削弱物理属性回归性能。 (3) 我们展示了物理嵌入在检索增强视频生成中的下游应用价值，表明更强的物理检索性能能够提升生成视频的物理保真度。 更广泛地说，这些结果表明，基于物理的表示是理解物理系统与改进生成世界模型之间的有效桥梁。

paragraphs.en: The World Embedding Benchmark evaluates the extent to which video representations preserve information about physical systems and their underlying parameters. The benchmark is built from 8000 physics simulation cases from 80 families across multiple branches: Fluid Mechanics, Solid Mechanics, Dynamics, and Optics & Electromagnetism. Each family contains 100 cases, representing the same physical system under different parameter settings.
paragraphs.zh: 世界嵌入基准测试评估视频表示在多大程度上保留了关于物理系统及其底层参数的信息。 该基准测试由来自 80 个家族、涵盖多个分支（流体力学、固体力学、动力学以及光学与电磁学）的 8000 个物理模拟案例构建而成。 每个家族包含 100 个案例，代表同一物理系统在不同参数设置下的表现。

paragraphs.en: The simulation cases support three complementary evaluation tasks: 1) Text-video retrieval , which evaluates the alignment between natural-language descriptions of physical systems and their corresponding video representations. 2) Physical property regression , which evaluates whether continuous quantities can be recovered from frozen video representations using lightweight regression models. 3) Pair classification , which evaluates whether models can distinguish the correct video-description correspondence from alternative candidates. Figure 1 summarizes the three evaluation tasks, which respectively assess cross-modal physical alignment, quantitative physical information recoverability, and fine-grained physical discrimination.
paragraphs.zh: 这些模拟案例支持三种互补的评估任务：1）文本-视频检索，用于评估对物理系统的自然语言描述与其对应的视频表示之间的对齐程度。2）物理属性回归，用于评估能否通过轻量级回归模型从冻结的视频表示中恢复连续数值。3）配对分类，用于评估模型能否在多个候选答案中正确区分出视频与描述的正确对应关系。 图1总结了这三种评估任务，分别用于检验跨模态的物理对齐能力、物理定量信息的可恢复性，以及精细的物理特征区分能力。

paragraphs.en: We construct the physics simulation subset from parameterized, representative scene families across Fluid Mechanics, Solid Mechanics, Dynamics, and Optics & Electromagnetism. Each instance is defined by its governing model, constitutive law, geometry, material parameters, boundary conditions, and initial conditions. Physical responses are generated using OpenFOAM for fluid mechanics ( OpenCFD, 2024 ; Weller et al., 1998 ) , FEniCSx/DOLFINx for solid mechanics ( Baratta et al., 2023 ) , Project Chrono for rigid-body and multibody dynamics ( Tasora et al., 2016 ) , and HCIPy together with Mitsuba 3 for optics and MEEP for electromagnetics ( Por et al., 2018 ; Jakob et al., 2022 ; Oskooi et al., 2010 ) . The exported fields and trajectories are rendered into PNG frames with ParaView 6.0.1 ( Ahrens et al., 2005 ) and encoded into MP4 clips with FFmpeg. The rendered clips therefore depict physically faithful responses with quantitative meaning, and generating evaluation data from validated simulators follows a growing line of scientific machine learning benchmarks ( Takamoto et al., 2022 ; Ohana et al., 2024a ; Luo et al., 2024 ) . Simulation provides explicit access to the generating parameters and computed physical states, enabling controlled evaluation of physical information in video representations. Representative examples from the four physics branches are shown in Figures 2 . Detailed formulations, computation methods, case parameters, and field outputs are provided in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从流体力学、固体力学、动力学以及光学与电磁学领域的参数化代表性场景族中构建物理模拟子集。 每个实例由其控制模型、本构定律、几何形状、材料参数、边界条件和初始条件定义。 物理响应通过以下工具生成：流体力学使用 OpenFOAM（OpenCFD, 2024；Weller 等，1998）；固体力学使用 FEniCSx/DOLFINx（Baratta 等，2023）；刚体和多体动力学使用 Project Chrono（Tasora 等，2016）；光学使用 HCIPy 与 Mitsuba 3，电磁学使用 MEEP（Por 等，2018；Jakob 等，2022；Oskooi 等，2010）。 导出的场和轨迹通过 ParaView 6.0.1（Ahrens 等，2005）渲染为 PNG 帧，并通过 FFmpeg 编码为 MP4 视频片段。 因此，这些渲染后的视频片段展示了具有定量意义的物理真实响应，而从经过验证的模拟器中生成评估数据，也遵循了科学机器学习基准测试日益发展的研究路线（Takamoto 等，2022；Ohana 等，2024a；Luo 等，2024）。 模拟过程能够明确获取生成参数和计算出的物理状态，从而支持对视频表现中物理信息的受控评估。 来自四个物理学分支的代表性示例展示于图 2 中。 详细的公式、计算方法、案例参数和场输出结果均列于附录 B 中。

paragraphs.en: To improve data quality and reduce duplication, we apply automated checks during dataset construction. These checks flag failed or non-convergent runs, NaN or infinite values, and unexpected physical responses. Video checks examine file properties and use sampled-frame statistics to identify blank, nearly static, or flickering videos. We also check case IDs and parameter settings for duplicates.
paragraphs.zh: 为了提高数据质量并减少重复，我们在数据集构建过程中应用自动化检查。 这些检查会标记失败或未收敛的运行、NaN 或无穷大值，以及意外的物理响应。 视频检查会分析文件属性，并利用采样帧的统计数据来识别空白、近乎静止或闪烁的视频。 我们还会检查案例 ID 和参数设置是否存在重复项。

paragraphs.en: The fluid dynamics subset contains 700 videos across seven families instantiated from 15 OpenFOAM configurations ( OpenCFD, 2024 ; Weller et al., 1998 ) . The configurations cover internal and external flows, cavity and buoyancy-driven flows, jets, non-Newtonian flow, and passive-scalar transport, including lid-driven cavity and backward-facing step flow ( Ghia et al., 1982 ; Armaly et al., 1983 ) . The case parameters include Reynolds and Péclet numbers, velocity, viscosity, geometry, scalar diffusivity, buoyancy parameters, and rheological parameters. Outputs include velocity, temperature, and transported-scalar fields. Further details are provided in Appendix B.2.1 .

paragraphs.en: The solid mechanics subset contains 2,700 videos across 27 families generated with FEniCSx/DOLFINx ( Baratta et al., 2023 ) . The families cover linear elasticity, finite-strain hyperelasticity, geometrically nonlinear deformation, indentation, stress concentration, and history-dependent response under tension, compression, bending, and torsion. The cases vary in material properties, geometry, and loading conditions, and the released videos primarily visualize displacement magnitude on the deformed geometry. Detailed formulations are provided in Appendix B.2.2 .

paragraphs.en: The dynamics subset contains 1,900 videos across 19 families combining Project Chrono ( Tasora et al., 2016 ) with Analytical / ODE integration. The families cover rigid-body motion, collision and contact, articulated mechanisms, vibration, wave propagation, rolling and sliding, rotating machinery, and structural response. The case parameters include geometry, mass, gravity, initial conditions, restitution and friction coefficients, stiffness and damping, and excitation conditions. Outputs include trajectories and family-specific quantities such as velocity, displacement, angular speed, stress, equivalent plastic strain, and damage. Detailed formulations are provided in Appendix B.2.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 动力学子集包含来自 19 个系列的 1,900 段视频，这些视频结合了 Project Chrono（Tasora 等人，2016）与解析/ODE 积分方法。 这些系列涵盖了刚体运动、碰撞与接触、铰接机构、振动、波传播、滚动与滑动、旋转机械以及结构响应。 案例参数包括几何形状、质量、重力、初始条件、恢复系数和摩擦系数、刚度与阻尼，以及激励条件。 输出结果包括轨迹以及各系列特有的物理量，例如速度、位移、角速度、应力、等效塑性应变和损伤。 详细的公式推导见附录 B.2.3。

paragraphs.en: The optics and electromagnetism subset contains 2,700 videos across 27 families. Nineteen optics families cover reflection and refraction, diffraction, interference, focusing, Gaussian-beam propagation, dispersion, and polarization, using analytical relations or HCIPy ( Por et al., 2018 ) , with Mitsuba 3 ( Jakob et al., 2022 ) used as an auxiliary backend for selected geometric-optics configurations. The remaining eight families use Meep FDTD ( Oskooi et al., 2010 ) for electromagnetic scattering, waveguides, photonic-crystal structures, gratings, dipole radiation, evanescent fields, and dispersive plasmonic systems. Detailed formulations and field definitions are provided in Appendix B.2.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 光学与电磁学子集包含 27 个系列中的 2,700 个视频。 19 个光学系列涵盖了反射与折射、衍射、干涉、聚焦、高斯光束传播、色散和偏振，这些内容通过解析关系或 HCIPy（Por 等人，2018）实现，其中 Mitsuba 3（Jakob 等人，2022）被用作部分几何光学配置的辅助后端。 其余 8 个系列使用 Meep FDTD（Oskooi 等人，2010）处理电磁散射、波导、光子晶体结构、光栅、偶极辐射、倏逝场以及色散等离激元系统。 详细的公式推导和场定义见附录 B.2.4。

paragraphs.en: We formulate physics-aware retrieval as bidirectional text-video retrieval within each physics branch. We evaluate both text-to-video and video-to-text retrieval over the full branch corpus and report their mean Recall@K. For example, the Solid Mechanics corpus contains 2,700 paired videos and queries from 27 families. For each family, we define a natural-language template describing the physical system, with slots for case-specific physical conditions, parameters, and derived quantities. These slots are instantiated from the simulation metadata, so queries within a family share similar wording but differ in the physical properties and numerical values associated with each case. See Figure 5 for an example of a natural-language template instantiated with metadata values.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将物理感知检索定义为每个物理分支内的双向文本-视频检索。 我们在整个分支语料库上评估了文本到视频和视频到文本两种检索方式，并报告了它们的平均 Recall@K。 例如，固体力学语料库包含来自 27 个系列的 2,700 对视频和查询。 对于每个系列，我们定义了一个描述物理系统的自然语言模板，其中包含用于特定案例的物理条件、参数和导出量的占位符。 这些占位符由模拟元数据实例化，因此同一系列内的查询具有相似的措辞，但每个案例相关的物理属性和数值有所不同。 关于使用元数据值实例化的自然语言模板示例，请参见图 5。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether quantitative physical information is recoverable from video representations, we define ten family-specific physical-property regression tasks. Each task associates one simulation family with a continuous scalar target, such as gravity, Reynolds number, wavelength, or elastic modulus. Given frozen video embeddings, we fit a linear regression probe to predict the target values 𝐲 ^ = [ y ^ 1 , … , y ^ N ] \hat{\mathbf{y}}=[\hat{y}_{1},\ldots,\hat{y}_{N}] from video representations alone. We report normalized root mean squared error (nRMSE) as the primary metric and Spearman’s rank correlation ρ \rho as a complementary measure of whether the predicted values preserve the ordering of the ground-truth property. Details of the regression targets and evaluation protocol are provided in Appendix C.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估能否从视频表示中恢复定量物理信息，我们定义了十个针对特定模拟族的物理属性回归任务。 每个任务都将一个模拟族与一个连续标量目标关联起来，例如重力、雷诺数、波长或弹性模量。 给定冻结的视频嵌入，我们拟合一个线性回归探针，仅基于视频表示来预测目标值 𝐲 ^ = [ y ^ 1 , … , y ^ N ] \hat{\mathbf{y}}=[\hat{y}_{1},\ldots,\hat{y}_{N}]。 我们将归一化均方根误差（nRMSE）作为主要指标，并将斯皮尔曼等级相关系数 ρ \rho 作为补充指标，用于衡量预测值是否保留了真实属性值的排序关系。 回归目标和评估协议的详细信息见附录 C.2。

paragraphs.en: Pair classification provides a lower-cost, controlled test of whether models can distinguish the correct video-text correspondence from alternatives. We sample 10 anchors per family and pair each with a within-family negative and a cross-family negative, yielding two binary settings. The former tests fine-grained sensitivity to physical properties and numerical values, while the latter tests discrimination across physical systems. For embedding models, we compare the anchor-positive similarity against the corresponding anchor-negative similarity. For MLLMs, we directly prompt the model to answer each binary multiple-choice question, rather than evaluating its embeddings. We report accuracy for both settings.
paragraphs.zh: 配对分类提供了一种成本更低且受控的测试方法，用于判断模型能否从多个选项中区分出正确的视频与文本对应关系。 我们为每个家族抽取 10 个锚点，并将每个锚点分别与一个家族内负样本和一个跨家族负样本配对，从而得到两种二元设置。 前者测试模型对物理属性和数值的精细敏感度，而后者则测试模型在不同物理系统之间的区分能力。 对于嵌入模型，我们将锚点与正样本的相似度与对应的锚点与负样本的相似度进行比较。 对于 MLLM，我们直接提示模型回答每个二元选择题，而不是评估其嵌入表示。 我们对这两种设置都报告了准确率。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate three classes of models with different representation paradigms. Embedding models include Video-CLIP-XL ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , Qwen3-VL-Embedding (2B and 8B) ( Li et al., 2026b ) , Omni-Embed-Nemotron 3B ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , and LCO-Embedding-Omni (3B and 7B) ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . These models provide both video and text embeddings and are therefore evaluated on all three benchmark tasks. JEPA models are represented by V-JEPA2 ( Assran et al., 2025 ) . As V-JEPA2 produces video representations without a corresponding text embedding space, we evaluate it only on physical-property regression using frozen video features. MLLMs include Qwen3.5 ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) and Qwen3.6 ( Qwen Team, 2026c ; Qwen Team, 2026b ) , each with 27B and 35B-A3B variants. Rather than extracting embeddings, we directly prompt these models to answer the pair-classification questions, providing a generative-model reference for physical video-text discrimination.

paragraphs.en: The main results are summarized in Table 2 . We make three observations. First, current pre-trained embedding models remain weak at physics-aware cross-modal alignment: retrieval performance stays low across all four physics branches, and within-family pair classification remains close to random chance, although cross-family discrimination is considerably easier. Second, directly prompted MLLMs perform substantially better on pair classification, reaching around 91–92% cross-family accuracy and 59–61% within-family accuracy. This suggests that stronger multimodal generative models already possess meaningful capabilities for understanding physical video-text correspondences, whereas current embedding models do not expose comparable capabilities through similarity matching, motivating us to study whether such capabilities can be better activated for representation learning. Third, V-JEPA2, despite being trained without text alignment, achieves strong physical-property regression performance with frozen video features. This suggests that predictive video representation learning itself can preserve substantial quantitative physical information, highlighting a distinction between modeling physical information in the representation and aligning it with language for similarity matching.
paragraphs.zh: 主要结果总结于表 2。 我们得出三个观察结果。 首先，当前的预训练嵌入模型在物理感知的跨模态对齐方面仍然表现较弱：在所有四个物理分支中，检索性能都保持在较低水平，且同一类别内的成对分类准确率仍接近随机猜测，尽管不同类别之间的区分要容易得多。 其次，直接提示的 MLLM 在成对分类任务中的表现显著更好，跨类别准确率可达约 91%–92%，同一类别内准确率为 59%–61%。 这表明，更强的多模态生成模型已经具备理解视频中物理实体与文本对应关系的有意义能力，而当前的嵌入模型则无法通过相似性匹配展现出类似的能力，这促使我们研究是否可以通过表示学习更好地激活此类能力。 第三，尽管 V-JEPA2 是在没有文本对齐的情况下训练的，但它在冻结视频特征的前提下仍实现了强大的物理属性回归性能。 这表明，预测性的视频表示学习本身能够保留大量定量的物理信息，这也凸显了在表示中建模物理信息与通过相似性匹配将其与语言对齐之间的区别。

paragraphs.en: We next ask whether physics adaptation can improve embedding model performance on our benchmark. Existing embedding models are rarely trained explicitly to capture physical information. Among the two dominant paradigms for multimodal retrieval, prior work has identified important mechanistic differences between CLIP and MLLM-based embedding models ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) . First, CLIP models exhibit a scaling plateau on complex tasks requiring spatial and compositional cross-modal alignment, where simply scaling model size or data provides limited gains. Second, MLLMs acquire richer multimodal knowledge through generative pretraining, as the LLM decoder learns to leverage multimodal information in a shared representation space; lightweight contrastive learning can then activate this latent alignment for similarity matching. Third, a generation-representation scaling pattern emerges: stronger generative models tend to provide higher representation upper bounds after contrastive activation.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们探讨物理适应性能否提升嵌入模型在我们基准测试上的表现。 现有的嵌入模型很少被明确训练以捕捉物理信息。 在多模态检索的两种主导范式之中，先前的研究已经识别出基于 CLIP 和 MLLM 的嵌入模型之间重要的机制差异（Xiao et al., 2025; Xiao et al., 2026）。 首先，CLIP 模型在需要空间与组合式跨模态对齐的复杂任务上表现出扩展平台期，此时单纯扩大模型规模或增加数据只能带来有限的提升。 其次，MLLM 通过生成式预训练获得了更丰富的多模态知识，因为 LLM 解码器学会了在共享的表示空间中利用多模态信息；随后，轻量级的对比学习可以激活这种潜在的对齐能力以进行相似性匹配。 第三，出现了一种生成-表示扩展模式：更强的生成模型在对比激活后往往能够提供更高的表示上限。

paragraphs.en: These observations motivate us to focus on the MLLM-based paradigm and ask whether physics capabilities already present in generative models can be released through physics-aware contrastive learning. Our setup therefore calls for a backbone with strong world knowledge, a validated contrastive activation recipe that permits injecting physics-aware examples while retaining general-domain data, and omnimodal support for video and audio, which also enables downstream retrieval-augmented video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些观察结果促使我们将重点放在基于 MLLM 的范式上，并探究生成模型中已存在的物理能力是否能够通过感知物理的对比学习被释放出来。 因此，我们的方案需要一个具备强大世界知识的骨干模型、一种经过验证的对比激活方法（该方法允许注入感知物理的示例，同时保留通用领域数据），以及对视频和音频的全模态支持，这也为下游的检索增强视频生成提供了可能。

sents.zh: 这些观察结果促使我们将重点放在基于 MLLM 的范式上，并探究生成模型中已存在的物理能力是否能够通过感知物理的对比学习被释放出来。

sents.en: Our setup therefore calls for a backbone with strong world knowledge, a validated contrastive activation recipe that permits injecting physics-aware examples while retaining general-domain data, and omnimodal support for video and audio, which also enables downstream retrieval-augmented video generation.
sents.zh: 因此，我们的方案需要一个具备强大世界知识的骨干模型、一种经过验证的对比激活方法（该方法允许注入感知物理的示例，同时保留通用领域数据），以及对视频和音频的全模态支持，这也为下游的检索增强视频生成提供了可能。

paragraphs.en: We adopt the training recipe of LCO-Embedding ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , an omnimodal embedding model trained with lightweight contrastive activation that achieves competitive performance across text, image, video, and audio embedding benchmarks.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 summarizes retrieval performance of models across training settings and steps. We make two observations: First, contrastive learning substantially improves physics-aware video retrieval for MLLM-based embedding models. Although recall@10 remains well below that of general-domain video-text retrieval ( Assadi et al., 2026b ) , it clearly surpasses the near-chance performance of the base model in Table 2 . Retrieval performance continues to improve throughout training and shows no signs of converging within our allocated training resources. paragraphs.en: Regression performance in Figure 6 , however, calls for a more nuanced interpretation. Across the 10 regression tasks, models continually trained on in-domain physics data mostly, if not consistently, underperform LCO-Embedding-Omni . We provide two possible interpretations. First, this observation is broadly consistent with Xiao et al. (2026) , which argues that contrastive learning primarily activates and calibrates MLLM capabilities rather than enhancing the underlying capabilities themselves. While in-domain physics training improves retrieval by better calibrating the similarity-matching space, a linear regression probe instead measures whether specific information is encoded and linearly accessible in the embeddings. As a side effect of this representation calibration, the model’s ability to encode certain physics properties may therefore degrade. Second, physics-property regression may benefit from training objectives beyond contrastive learning, such as explicit representation regression losses, similar to objectives used to optimize semantic textual similarity in text embedding models.

paragraphs.en: We benchmark the performance on PhyGenBench ( Meng et al., 2025 ) , and take a closer look at two physics branches related to World Embedding Benchmark. The results are displayed in Table 3 . As a frontier open-weight model, MiniMax-H3 without RAG already achieves strong PhyGenBench performance. paragraphs.en: Numerical benchmarks evaluate surrogate models on parameterized physical systems ( Takamoto et al., 2022 ; Bonnet et al., 2022 ; Gupta and Brandstetter, 2023 ; Toshev et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2024 ; Ohana et al., 2024b ) , while visual benchmarks study causal reasoning and event prediction in simulated environments ( Riochet et al., 2020 ; Yi et al., 2020 ; Bear et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Existing work therefore focuses mainly on either numerical fields or object-level dynamics. Our benchmark instead renders simulations across four physics domains as videos paired with physical quantities, enabling retrieval and physical property regression on video representations.

paragraphs.en: Omnimodal representation learning has progressed from image-text alignment ( Radford et al., 2021 ) to unified embedding spaces across modalities ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) . Recent models support videos and visual documents ( Meng et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Xiao et al., 2024a ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) , interleaved inputs ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , and audio or composed multimodal queries ( Huynh et al., 2026 ) . (2026) have expanded the evaluation, covering a broader range of modalities and reveals persistent modality bias and asymmetric cross-modal retrieval. Complementing this broad semantic evaluation, our benchmark focuses on whether video embeddings preserve fine-grained physical information, as measured by physical-description alignment and quantitative property recovery.

paragraphs.en: We introduced the World Embedding Benchmark to evaluate how video representations capture and align physical information. Across 8,000 controlled simulation cases, we find that pre-trained omnimodal embeddings preserve recoverable physical signals but exhibit weak cross-modal physical alignment. Physics-specific contrastive adaptation improves retrieval and pair classification, but degrades physical-property regression, revealing a trade-off between alignment and quantitative information recoverability. Finally, physically relevant retrieval improves the fidelity of generated videos, with stronger retrieval models yielding larger gains. These results highlight the importance of jointly evaluating physical alignment and information recoverability when developing representations for physically grounded world models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了世界嵌入基准，用于评估视频表示如何捕捉和对齐物理信息。 在 8,000 个受控模拟案例中，我们发现预训练的全模态嵌入能够保留可恢复的物理信号，但在跨模态物理对齐方面表现较弱。 针对物理特性的对比适应方法提升了检索和配对分类效果，但降低了物理属性回归的准确性，揭示了物理对齐与定量信息可恢复性之间的权衡关系。 最后，与物理相关的检索提升了生成视频的保真度，且检索模型越强，提升效果越显著。 这些结果凸显了在开发基于物理的世界模型表示时，联合评估物理对齐与信息可恢复性的重要性。

paragraphs.en: The retrieval evaluation contains one primary query for each simulation case.
